title: Introduce staged fallback executor and region-lease rewrite
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Background: The current smart-routing fallback pipeline evaluates fallbacks inline on the hot path and relies on a global in-memory lease map per region. This causes contention under bursts and makes it hard to add staged, graded fallbacks (eg. model-variant downgrade -> region fallback -> tiered capacity fallback) without increasing tail latency.

Goal: Introduce a staged fallback executor that separates evaluation (fast heuristic) from execution (queued, backpressure-aware) and replace the global region lease map with a lightweight region-lease service that exposes lease tokens and TTL refresh APIs. This should reduce lock contention, make fallback sequencing explicit, and enable safe canary/degraded modes.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end staged fallback path implemented behind a feature flag.
- Measured p95 tail latency for routing hotpath improves or remains within 5% of baseline under synthetic burst test.
- Region lease service implemented with clear contract and minimal RPC overhead; fallback executor uses leases for region-level capacity coordination.
- Unit and integration tests covering failure modes (lease expiry, RPC timeout, fallback execution abort).
- Documentation PR and design note published.

Non-goals: This ticket does not replace the policy language itself or add new routing heuristics — it only refactors the runtime and lease coordination plumbing.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Spike: microbenchmarked lock contention on current lease map. Observed ~3x increase in lock hold time at 10k rps burst. Notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PL/ENG-99201-spike

2026-02-23 - Design review with PM and Runtime: agreed to staged executor model (evaluate -> enqueue -> dispatch) and to implement region-lease as a lightweight gRPC service with optional in-process fallback for private deployments.

2026-02-27 - Trade-offs: synchronous RPC for lease check adds ~0.6ms median. To keep hotpath low, we moved evaluation heuristics ahead of lease RPC and only perform lease RPC for candidate fallback targets (not every request). This reduces RPCs by ~70% in our workload samples.
2026-03-01 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2487 - introduces staged executor scaffolding and region-lease proto. Requesting eng review from @jules and @mayank.
2026-03-05 - Perf run in staging: under 12k rps burst, p95 routing latency improved by 18% and CPU steal reduced on router nodes. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ROUTING/eng-99201
2026-03-08 - Code review comments addressed: added metrics for enqueue depth and lease RTT; added backpressure circuit that will demote requests to best-effort path when queue > 5000.
2026-03-10 - Blocker: dependency on upgraded grpc-client v1.14 (ENG-100102). Failing CI in private deploy pipeline. Coordinating with infra team for staged rollout.
